samples.question: A pale instrument sheet carries grey ticks and several coloured or grey marks, and exactly three solid pure-black horizontal bars that sit close together in one small group. Ignore every mark that is not pure black. The three black bars have different thicknesses and are not aligned with one another, so measure each black bar only by its own length from its left end to its right end and ignore its thickness, its height on the sheet and where it starts. Is the single longest black bar longer than the other two black bars laid end to end in one straight line? Answer yes or no.
